settings.departurePoint: French Harbour Marina, Roatán, Bay Islands, Honduras
settings.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 7 days before departure. Within 7 days the deposit is non-refundable. Trips cancelled by us for weather are fully refunded or rescheduled at no cost.

vessels.name: Private Luxury Full Day Speedboat Adventure
vessels.tagline: Twin 200s, a shaded T-top, and the whole island at your pace.
vessels.description: Li'l Knotty is our centre console — twin 200 hp Suzukis, shade over the helm and a hull that gets you to the far side of the island before the crowds. We run the day at your pace: snorkel the reef, get pulled on the tube, and swim off the sand at Pigeon Cay.
includes: Li'l Knotty, a private centre console with twin 200 hp outboards
Bow seating and cushioned casting deck
Snorkeling gear and guided reef stop

vessels.name: Private Luxury Full Day Yacht Charter
vessels.tagline: 47 feet of shade, air conditioning and open water.
vessels.description: Lounge in luxury and enjoy proper pampering aboard Knotty, our private 47' yacht, tailored just for you and your group. Teak cockpit under canvas shade, air-conditioned cabin when the sun gets serious, a tender on the swim platform for the shallow stuff, and a captain who knows every reef worth stopping at.
includes: Knotty, a private 47' yacht with two staterooms
Shaded teak cockpit with dining table
Bow sunpad and teak swim platform

vessels.name: Copper Package — 4 Nights, 5 Days
vessels.tagline: Live aboard for four nights. Wake up somewhere new.
vessels.description: Escape to paradise on an all-inclusive private yacht getaway. Four nights aboard a 47' two-stateroom yacht, mixing adventure and doing absolutely nothing, in whatever proportion you like.
includes: Captain and crew for the full stay

vessels.name: Silver Package — 5 Nights, 6 Days
vessels.tagline: Two islands, five nights, one yacht that is only yours.
vessels.description: Luxury and adventure across two islands. Five nights aboard, with the itinerary shaped around what your group actually wants to do — reefs, beaches, or a very slow lunch.
includes: Captain and crew for the full stay

vessels.name: Gold Package — 6 Nights, 7 Days
vessels.tagline: The whole Caribbean week. Yacht, hotel, and a speedboat on the house.
vessels.description: Experience the best of the Caribbean where opulence meets breathtaking natural beauty. Six nights split between the yacht and hotel stays, with a complimentary speedboat day included.

gallery.caption: On plane off the south shore. This is what most of the speedboat day looks like.
Knotty at the dock in French Harbour, tender ready on the teak platform.
The shaded cockpit — where most of a charter day actually gets spent.
Teak table set for lunch, helm behind it.
Helm and wet bar. Ice, sink and the drinks within arm’s reach.
Dinner aboard after dark, with the harbour lights behind you.
The master stateroom, turned down for an overnight charter.
Twin 200 hp Suzukis and a shark on the hull, tied up at the marina.

extras.name: Champagne toast
extras.description: A chilled bottle of Moët and proper glassware, poured wherever you tell the captain to stop.

extras.name: Fresh flower setup
extras.description: Tropical arrangements through the cabin and deck, cut the morning of your trip.

extras.name: Custom cake
extras.description: Your message on it. Tell us the occasion and any allergies.

extras.name: Proposal setup
extras.description: Deck lettering, petals, chilled champagne and a crew that knows exactly when to disappear.

extras.name: Cabin turndown
extras.description: Rose petals, candles through the stateroom and a chilled bottle waiting. Overnight charters only.

extras.name: Photographer (2 hours)
extras.description: A local photographer aboard, edited gallery delivered within 72 hours.

extras.name: Drone footage
extras.description: Aerial video of the boat, the reef and your group, edited to a short film.

extras.name: Live guitar
extras.description: A local guitarist aboard for two hours of the trip.

extras.name: Lobster lunch
extras.description: Caribbean lobster grilled aboard, with plantain, rice and salad.

extras.name: Caribbean BBQ
extras.description: Grilled fish, chicken and pork with island sides, served on the water.

extras.name: Vegetarian spread
extras.description: Grilled vegetables, fresh cheeses, hummus, breads and island fruit.

extras.name: Fruit and cheese table
extras.description: A full spread of in-season island fruit, cheeses and crackers.

extras.name: Red wine (bottle)
extras.description: Malbec or Cabernet. Ask the crew for the current list.

extras.name: White or rosé (bottle)
extras.description: Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay or Provence rosé, served properly cold.

extras.name: Premium open bar
extras.description: Top-shelf rum, whiskey, gin and mixers for the whole trip.

extras.name: Cocktail bartender
extras.description: A bartender aboard making frozen and classic cocktails to order.

extras.name: Tubing session
extras.description: Towable tube and safety gear, as many runs as your group can take.

extras.name: Extra snorkel sets
extras.description: Additional masks, snorkels and fins beyond what the boat carries.

extras.name: Paddleboard
extras.description: Inflatable SUP aboard for the day.

extras.name: Double kayak
extras.description: Two-person kayak for exploring the mangroves and shallows.

extras.name: Fishing gear and guide
extras.description: Rods, tackle and a crew member who knows where they are biting.

extras.name: Discover scuba (per diver)
extras.description: One guided dive on the reef with a certified instructor. No experience needed.

extras.name: Tender island hop
extras.description: Take the tender off the swim platform and land where the yacht cannot go — sandbars, mangrove cuts, an empty beach.

extras.name: Pigeon Cay beach stop
extras.description: Add the sandbar and beach club stop to your route, entry included.

extras.name: Hotel or cruise pickup
extras.description: Air-conditioned round-trip transfer between your hotel or the cruise terminal and the marina.

extras.name: Massage aboard
extras.description: A licensed therapist aboard, 50 minutes on the shaded deck.

extras.name: Kids kit
extras.description: Child-size life vests, floats, snacks and shade for the little ones.

extras.name: Premium towels and shade
extras.description: Oversized towels, extra umbrella and a cushioned bow setup.

extras.name: Extra cooler of drinks
extras.description: A second stocked cooler of water, sodas and local beer.

extras.name: WiFi aboard
extras.description: Portable hotspot with island coverage for the trip.
